metadata.projection_spec: All18 DeltaNet layers; fixed INT8 tile64; dynamic group64 input probability; T4096; exact Binomial count compression; shared input stream for QKV/z in combined scope; BF16 I/O, FP32 reference accumulation.
metadata.state_spec: Original alpha/beta, Conv1d+SiLU, Q/K L2 norm, recurrent/chunked update, RMSNormGated, original state precision; one model update per token, no update per sampling bit.
metadata.combined_spec: If combined: all24 dynamic INT8 FFN input4096/output3072 update256 burn25%, plus six full-attention PV512; otherwise all FFNs and full attention original.
